title: Show one confirmation after a redirect
goal: Carry one-use feedback across a static SSR redirect with TempData.

selectionNotes: RC2 writes bound values back: copy then clear for one-use display.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: These component state contracts require the .NET 11 shared framework.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against ASP.NET Core 11 reference assemblies; the exact RC2 pin is a test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no preview syntax or experimental opt-in.

prerequisites: Use a Web SDK net11.0 project, nullable/implicit usings and the imports shown in the Markdown. Call AddRazorComponents before Build. Preserve antiforgery protection for static forms.
Default cookie TempData is registered by AddRazorComponents. Read or write before the response starts.

Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Endpoints and Components.Web runtime/reference assemblies from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App. The Web SDK resolves aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets; exact versions and lockfiles are verification baselines.
ASP.NET Core server hosting with HTTP cookies; actual Windows x64 loopback Kestrel execution. No native workload or external service required.
Static SSR only; interactive Server/WebAssembly/Auto values are not supplied after interactive activation.
Stable APIs measured on .NET 11 RC2; final GA reconciliation remains outstanding.
Default cookie TempData; shared Data Protection keys across instances.
constraints: Storage is tied to the request and browser cookies, not a circuit, authenticated identity or durable database. No net10.0 package route is claimed.
Use unique case-insensitive keys per supplied property in one rendered page. Supported scalar/collection values only; arbitrary user-defined JSON classes are not supported.
No concurrent-update atomicity, durable permit record, multi-server provider execution, interactive hydration, browser UI automation or GA execution is claimed.
Static SSR only; cookie/header timing matters under streaming. Use session-storage TempData for writes after the first flush, with early session establishment.
RC2 bound TempData properties are written back; copy the display value then clear the property for a one-use confirmation.

selectionNotes: Late writes: cache+AddSession+UseSession; cookie before streaming flush.
Reads consume; copy then clear RC2 bound values.
